component.name: Kitty Chrome
component.summary: Terminal with compact native window chrome

description.p: Kitty Chrome packages the Kitty terminal with native Wayland GTK4 decorations and a compact, auto-hiding titlebar.
The window controls sit in a pop-over that overlays the grid instead of reserving a strip above it, and appear only while the pointer is near them, so the terminal runs to the top edge of the window.
Terminal children run on the host rather than inside the sandbox, on a real host PTY, so shells, containers and SSH behave as they would outside Flatpak.
Packaging split into its own repository, and the Ptyxis agent no longer leaves a spawned scope's process tree to systemd, which had stalled every logout and reboot for 45 seconds.
